item.text: {"question_id":"4B.9","answer":"For 2023, the supplied record does not establish presidential procurement or operation of spyware, targeted interception, nationwide internet shutdowns, or online-content censorship: the US Department of State reported that the government did not restrict or disrupt internet access or censor online content. [BATCH-0011-E011] That qualification does not eliminate documented digital and administrative suppression. The Digital Code criminalized dissemination of information deemed false online, while the revised press law retained imprisonment for press offenses and added a bad-faith false-information provision. [BATCH-0011-E011, BATCH-0025-E007] Authorities and security or judicial officials detained journalists over reporting, criticism, tweets, or alleged false information, including Kiomba and Ebondo, Bakuka, Kayiba, Ngongo Lomango, and Bujakera; in Ngongo’s case authorities retained his phone intending to search it. [BATCH-0025-E011, BATCH-0026-E011, BATCH-0025-E012] The state of siege, enforced and repeatedly extended by Tshisekedi’s government, transferred civilian administration to military and police officers and was associated with harassment, detention, and mass pretrial detention of critics, journalists, activists, and political figures. [BATCH-0012-R03-E001, BATCH-0012-R03-E002, BATCH-0012-R03-E003] During the December elections, a media regulator ordered Perfect Télévision off air after reports about delayed polling and missing electoral materials; party-linked supporters also attacked journalists, although the supplied accounts do not show that Tshisekedi personally ordered or endorsed either incident. [BATCH-0027-E002, BATCH-0027-E003] The Goma operation further shows coercive suppression of political assembly, including a preemptive protest ban, a planned security operation, killings, arrests, and confiscation of radio equipment, but the evidence attributes direct operational responsibility to regional military authorities rather than proving a presidential order. [BATCH-0010-E013, BATCH-0011-E018] Tshisekedi’s state-of-siege review roundtable and statement that he would not intervene in Bujakera’s case are qualifying signals, but neither demonstrates effective correction or lawful oversight. [BATCH-0021-E012, BATCH-0025-E013] Overall, the evidence supports a pattern of criminal-law restrictions, journalist detention, phone retention, broadcaster shutdown, protest suppression, and administrative harassment, while leaving surveillance procurement, interception, nationwide internet controls, and direct personal presidential authorization unestablished.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0011-E011","BATCH-0025-E007","BATCH-0025-E011","BATCH-0026-E011","BATCH-0025-E012","BATCH-0012-R03-E001","BATCH-0012-R03-E002","BATCH-0012-R03-E003","BATCH-0027-E003","BATCH-0011-E018","BATCH-0010-E013"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0021-E012","BATCH-0025-E013","BATCH-0027-E002"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No supplied evidence establishes spyware procurement, targeted interception, surveillance-data access, or a nationwide internet shutdown.","The reported absence of internet restriction, disruption, or online-content censorship is not evidence that all digital or media controls were absent; the Perfect Télévision broadcast shutdown is a distinct regulator action.","Most incidents are attributed to agencies, security forces, regulators, officials, or party supporters rather than a direct presidential order.","The state-of-siege transition, announced review, and investigations do not show that abuses were fully remedied or independently overseen.","Some allegations and casualty figures remain disputed or unresolved, and several sources do not report final judicial outcomes."],"corrections_made":["Restored the material qualification that the government did not restrict or disrupt internet access or censor online content.","Removed CENI audit terms and EU election observation as purported surveillance-oversight evidence.","Added the broader journalist-detention, phone-retention, party-linked attack, and broadcaster-shutdown pattern while distinguishing those mechanisms from spyware, interception, and internet shutdowns.","Preserved attribution limits by distinguishing government-wide or agency conduct from direct presidential authorization."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":[]}
